headword: {肉野菜炒|にくやさいいた}め
gloss: stir-fried meat and vegetables; meat and vegetable stir-fry

definitions.gloss: stir-fried meat and vegetables; meat and vegetable stir-fry

examples.japanese: {今晩|こんばん}は{肉野菜炒|にくやさいいた}めにしよう。
examples.english: Let's have stir-fried meat and vegetables tonight.

examples.japanese: {定食屋|ていしょくや}で{肉野菜炒|にくやさいいた}めを{注文|ちゅうもん}した。
examples.english: I ordered stir-fried meat and vegetables at the set-meal restaurant.

examples.japanese: {冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}に{残|のこ}った{野菜|やさい}と{豚肉|ぶたにく}で{肉野菜炒|にくやさいいた}めを{作|つく}れば、{簡単|かんたん}に{栄養|えいよう}バランスの{良|よ}い{食事|しょくじ}になる。
examples.english: If you make stir-fried meat and vegetables with leftover vegetables and pork from the fridge, you can easily have a nutritionally balanced meal.

notes:
A straightforward compound describing a common home-cooked and restaurant dish: {肉|にく} (meat) + {野菜|やさい} (vegetables) + {炒|いた}め (stir-fry). It is a staple of everyday Japanese cooking and appears frequently on {定食|ていしょく} (set meal) menus.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肉野菜炒|にくやさいいた}め{定食|ていしょく}: stir-fried meat and vegetables set meal
- {豚|ぶた}{肉野菜炒|にくやさいいた}め: pork and vegetable stir-fry
- {肉野菜炒|にくやさいいた}めを{作|つく}る: to make meat and vegetable stir-fry

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {野菜炒|やさいいた}め: vegetable stir-fry (without meat)
- {回鍋肉|ホイコーロー}: twice-cooked pork (Chinese-style stir-fry; more specific dish with doubanjiang sauce)
- {焼|や}きそば: fried noodles (also a stir-fried dish, but with noodles as the base)

REGISTER:
This is an everyday cooking term. On restaurant menus, it may also appear as {野菜|やさい}{肉炒|にくいた}め (with the order reversed).
